**Proposed mechanism:** BAX (HGNC:959) —DISRUPTS→ Apoptosis (GO:0006915); Apoptosis (GO:0006915) —LEADS_TO→ Dilated cardiomyopathy (MONDO:0011541); Apoptosis (GO:0006915) —LEADS_TO→ Leukemia, acute lymphocytic, susceptibility to, 1 (MONDO:0013108). Loss-of-function mutations in BAX disrupt the apoptotic pathway, leading to dilated cardiomyopathy due to insufficient removal of damaged cells and increased susceptibility to leukemia due to impaired clearance of malignant cells.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in BAX exclusively associated with gain-of-function mechanisms in either disease would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs1800872)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of BAX in apoptosis could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting apoptotic pathways for both cardiac and hematologic malignancies.
